TTD-34022(31)/250/2023-PROCURMENT SEC-TTD In this regard, in order check the quality of Ghee supplied by the firm M/s A R Dairy Food Private Limited, 3(Three) samples were collected on 06.07.2024 from the consignment supplied by the firm to TTD through the tanker bearing no. AP26 TC 4779 at Tirumala and one sample was sent to laboratory of NDDB (National Dairy Development Board) CALF (Centre for Analysis and learning in Livestock & Food), which is a multidisciplinary analytical laboratory at NDDB Anand, Gujarat. CALF has been accredited as per the ISO/IEC 17025 by the National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories (**NABL**) in 2013 for chemical and biological testing. Biological scope covers both microbiology and genetics testing. The remaining two samples were kept at TTD lab and warehouse for further reference. In this regard, it is to inform that it is the prime responsibility of the supplier to adhere to the terms and conditions of the agreement invariably before delivery of the materials. The conditions which elaborated in respect of the various standard specifications and in case of breach of the contract are detailed below for reference. As per **clause.10** of agreement, it is stated that i) “The supply of cow ghee is meant for preparation of the sacred prasadams of Lord Venkateswara swamy and every care should be taken by the supplier to see that there is no variation in the quality of supply. Each supply will be accepted subject to Lab Test only.” ii) Vide clause. 23 of agreement “The supply of Cow Ghee with Agmark Special grade should strictly conform to the following specifications.” *Table - 1*

In view of the above, it is to inform that, the ghee samples collected from Tanker No. AP26 TC 4779 on 06.07.2024 were analyzed for quality as per the test parameters prescribed under the Food Safety and Standards Regulation by NABL-accredited laboratory as per ISO/IEC 17025:2017. From the obtained results, it is evident that the ghee supplied to TTD through tanker no. AP26 TC 4779 is adulterated. The presence of β-sitosterol (plant sterol) in the supplied consignment in the supplied ghee indicates that the ghee is adulterated with the fat of vegetable origin. Moreover, the fatty acid profile and the triglyceride composition pattern also do not comply with that of milk fat and indicate the presence of foreign fat (Table -2 and Annexure-1). The identification of β- sitosterol and the fatty acid profile do not comply with the specifications laid down under Food Safety and Standards Regulation, 2011 and hence can be declared as adulterated, as per FSS Regulation, 2011 and Agmark special grade standards.

TTD-34022(31)/250/2023-PROCURMENT SEC-TTD

It is therefore evident that, the firm has violated the terms and conditions of the
contract agreement by not adhering to the specifications as per prescribed standards
of FSSR and Agmark special grade vide clause No.23 and 74 of agreement and
therefore under clause 47,49 and 65 of the agreement you are liable for blacklisting.

In view of the above, you are hereby called on to “show cause” as to why
suitable action should not be taken to blacklist the firm duly forfeiting the EMD & SD
amounts and penalty of 5% within 7 (seven) days from the date of receipt of this show
cause notice, failing which it is construed that you have nothing to say in this regard
and suitable action as warranted under contract agreement shall be initiated against
you on the evidence of available records without any further notice.

In the service of the Lord Venkateswara

General Manager (Procurement)

Copy to the Dy.Exe.Officer (WH), TTD, Tirupati for information.
